sector: Independent residential brokerage selling coastal Maine homes, from corner lot starters to waterfront point estates, to local and out of state buyers.
founded_place_size: Founded 2009, harbour front office on the mid coast of Maine, eight agents under principal Dana Marlow.
about: Harborline is a small owner run brokerage that lists the whole mid coast book, a three hundred and twenty thousand dollar starter one week and a waterfront estate the next. It runs on repeat referrals and reputation in town, and prints a fresh listing sheet for every active property each Monday. Dana Marlow built it to feel like the place it sells, not a national franchise.
audience: Two buyers in one weekly run: estate buyers over fifty with liquid capital who read restraint as credibility, and first time buyers under thirty five who need price, bed count and open house time to land at a glance.
price_positioning: One brokerage spanning a 320 thousand dollar starter to a 4.5 million dollar point estate; the sheet has to flex between the two without either register looking wrong. Weekly production retainer, roughly 700 to 1,600 dollars a month.

palette.name: Cream (window mark)
palette.usage: The sheet ground, as on listingsheet_2025_press.pdf, and the only ground or panel colour. It is the cream the mark is painted in on the office window (officesign_photo.jpg); on the Cream sheet it is never a type or mark colour.

palette.name: Deep Harbour Navy
palette.usage: The headline, the description and the price, as on listingsheet_2025_press.pdf. It may also colour the mark. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Weathered Rope Tan
palette.usage: The mark only, as one of its three permitted colours. Never a rule or hairline, since the type system allows no rule but the price's, and never a ground, panel, label or line of record text.

palette.name: Sea Slate
palette.usage: The address, the beds, baths and square feet strip, the agent line and the reference code, as on listingsheet_2025_press.pdf. It may also colour the mark. Never a ground, panel or rule.

palette.name: Buoy Red
palette.usage: Only the 2 pt rule directly under the price, cut to the price figure's exact width, as the signature move sets it. Never type, the price itself, a ground, a panel, the mark or any other rule.

typography: Harborline runs two faces and no more. Step 01 is the asking price in Bradford Regular at 46 pt on 50 pt, tracking -0.01 em, in tabular lining figures, dropping to 28 pt on 31 pt in the estate register; the 2 pt Buoy Red rule sits directly under it, cut to that figure's exact width. Step 02 is the listing headline in Bradford Regular at 24 pt on 27 pt, tracking -0.005 em, 61 px on screen. Step 03 is body in Söhne Buch at 10 pt on 14 pt, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters. Step 04 is the agent line in Söhne Buch at 8.5 pt on 12 pt, tracking 0.02 em, with the spec strip one step above it at 9.5 pt on 13 pt. Nothing in the system is ever ruled except the price.
voice: Plain, grounded, mid coast. We describe the house, not ourselves, and never oversell. Example line the brand would write: 'Corner lot, three beds, a short walk to the harbour. Open Sunday, one to three.'
brand_assets_status: The original logo artwork was lost years ago. The only surviving version of the mark, a rope ring around a lighthouse with the letters H and R, is the one painted in cream on the office window. There are no brand guidelines or type specimen; the retired printer's last press file is the sole reference for the listing sheet.
values: Honesty about price and condition, and one consistent office look across every listing no matter who shot the photograph.

scale.note: The asking price, and the only element the Buoy Red rule ever touches. Tabular lining figures always. The estate register drops the same row to 28 pt on 31 pt so a 4.5 million dollar point estate and a starter sheet read as one office.

type_system.signature_move: The price rule: a 2 pt Buoy Red line sits directly beneath the step 01 price, cut to that figure's exact width, so it lengthens for a waterfront estate and shortens for a starter. It is the only rule anywhere in the system, and prices are always set in Bradford tabular lining figures.
rules: Never rule anything but the price. The 2 pt Buoy Red rule is the only rule in the system.
The price rule is cut to the exact width of the price figure, never to the column or the measure.
Prices are always set in Bradford tabular lining figures.
Headlines and asking prices take Bradford; the spec strip, body and agent line take Söhne Buch.
One office look across every listing, whoever shot the photograph.

palette_rules.distribution: Cream is the ground and the only ground or panel colour, as on listingsheet_2025_press.pdf. On Cream, the headline, description and price are Deep Harbour Navy, and the address, beds, baths and square feet strip, agent line and reference code are Sea Slate, as on listingsheet_2025_press.pdf. Buoy Red is only the 2 pt price rule. The mark is one solid colour: Deep Harbour Navy, Sea Slate or Weathered Rope Tan, and Weathered Rope Tan is used nowhere but the mark. Buoy Red and Weathered Rope Tan together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, the mark is never a ghosted or transparent watermark, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark. No rule or hairline of any colour except the Buoy Red price rule. No red type, red price, red panel or red ground: principal_note.txt names a loud, red franchise storefront as what Harborline is not.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own natural colour and are never tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward the palette. Correcting a frame's tone or cast is allowed; pushing a photograph toward Deep Harbour Navy, Sea Slate, Weathered Rope Tan, Cream or Buoy Red is not.
